**Summary:**

Goal status check first: I was already at level 5 (10,087 exp) from the prior session — the "237 exp left" framing in this task was stale. Still, went hunting as instructed rather than sit idle.

Walked from The Secret Yard back to the Newbie Zone's deeper passage (through A Nexus's north door, already open from last visit) and found A Bright Hallway crawling with targets — a newbie, several "lost newbie" spawns, and a creepy little crawling thing. Racked up six clean kills for a total of +156 exp (10,087 → 10,243), no damage worse than 88% health at any point.

**Oddity worth flagging:** none of these six kills left a lootable corpse — `get all corpse` and even `look corpse` came up empty every time, unlike earlier sessions where corpses sat there with coins/items. Possibly a fast despawn/no-drop variant of these particular spawns, or they're coinless trash versions reusing the "lost newbie" name. Didn't get to record this via `remember_learning` before

This South Stairs spot is proving to be the best farm ground found yet, with huge exp variance on the backstab opener. Ending the turn here on a strong note.

text:
Great haul this turn:

- Looted leftover corpses at South Stairs (30g + a bright green newbie vest from the talkative newbie that had died of its wounds).
- Moved to North Stairs and found the pet dragon — previously flagged as an even-match "perfect match" at level 4, but now considers **Fairly easy** at level 5. Backstabbed it for a huge **+429 exp**.
- A second baby dragon had already respawned and was mid-attack; finished it off for **+56 exp**.

**Status: exp 10,961 → 11,446, HP 63/68 (93%), gold +30.** No dice on corpse loot from the dragons themselves. Updated my notes so future runs know the dragon's now fair game rather than something to avoid. Staying well clear of the Minotaur's stairway — everything fought this turn was clearly winnable per `consider`. Ending the turn here on a high note.

goal: reach level 5 — only 237 experience left, one or two kills. Hunt the deeper Newbie Zone passages where you had success last time (past the old hallway loop, which is farmed out).
